result.summary: The layout is broadly coherent for a food-delivery home screen, but there is a visible spelling error in the search field, an inconsistently styled favorite button, and text truncation without an ellipsis in the horizontal carousel.

issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled differently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/translucent circle with a light heart, creating an inconsistent and lower-contrast control.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite-button treatment (same background, size and icon color) across all cards, ensuring adequate contrast over any image.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third item's title is hard-clipped mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') and the card image is cut off at the screen edge without a visual affordance or ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Truncate titles with an ellipsis and add consistent peek/padding plus a scroll indicator so partially visible cards read as intentionally scrollable.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut flush at the right edge with a sliver of the next chip visible, which can look like a rendering glitch rather than a scrollable row.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing padding and/or a fade mask so the partially visible chip clearly signals horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is cropped by the bottom navigation bar with no bottom content inset, so its title/details are hidden behind the nav area.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scroll container equal to the nav bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell with red dot, heart buttons) have no visible text label, and the '-20%' / '€0 delivery' badges rely on color alone for emphasis.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible labels for icon buttons (e.g. 'Notifications, 1 new', 'Add to favorites') and ensure badge meaning is conveyed by text as well as color.
